prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a THREE-FRAME limited-animation key-pose SPRITE SHEET of this exact Song dynasty Buddhist monk sweeping, seen from the same high three-quarter angle as the reference. Keep his identity: shaven head, grey robe with cream inner collar and cuffs, brown prayer beads at his waist, dark cloth shoes, the SAME long bamboo broom with a full straw head. Feet stay planted in exactly the same spot in all cells; both hands always hold the broom handle, upper hand near the top, lower hand mid-handle. Cell 1 (left) = rest pose matching the reference: broom angled down to his right, straw resting on the ground. Cell 2 (middle) = mid-sweep: broom swept across in front of his feet toward his left, straw bending against the ground, a few small leaves skidding ahead of it, torso turning gently with the stroke. Cell 3 (right) = recovery: broom lifted just off the ground and carried back to his right, straw straightened, torso returning upright. Calm, unhurried temple routine. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 3 equal-width cells, one full figure per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so tools and hands never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Make every cell match the reference figure and match each other as strictly as possible.
